name: 6β-naltrexol
summary: 6β-Naltrexol, or 6β-hydroxynaltrexone (developmental code name AIKO-150), is a peripherally-selective opioid receptor antagonist related to naltrexone. It is a major active metabolite of naltrexone formed by hepatic dihydrodiol dehydrogenase enzymes.

pharmacology.text: 6β-Naltrexol, or 6β-hydroxynaltrexone (developmental code name AIKO-150), is a peripherally-selective opioid receptor antagonist related to naltrexone. It is a major active metabolite of naltrexone formed by hepatic dihydrodiol dehydrogenase enzymes. Relative to naltrexone, 6β-naltrexol has about half the affinity for the MOR.

uses.en: It has been studied as a treatment for constipation caused by opioids and for other effects of opioids outside the brain.
uses.zh: 它曾被研究用於治療鴉片類藥物引起的便秘，以及鴉片類藥物在腦外造成的其他作用。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被研究用于治疗鸦片类药物引起的便秘，以及鸦片类药物在脑外造成的其他作用。

sideEffects.en: Little is known about it in people. Opioid blockers can bring on sudden withdrawal in someone who is dependent on opioids, causing sweating, cramps, vomiting, diarrhoea and severe distress.
sideEffects.zh: 目前對它在人體的作用所知甚少。鴉片類拮抗劑可能讓已對鴉片類藥物產生依賴的人突然進入戒斷狀態，出現冒汗、腹部痙攣、嘔吐、腹瀉與強烈的不適。
sideEffects.zhHans: 目前对它在人体的作用所知甚少。鸦片类拮抗剂可能让已对鸦片类药物产生依赖的人突然进入戒断状态，出现冒汗、腹部痉挛、呕吐、腹泻与强烈的不适。

fact.en: It is the main compound the body makes from naltrexone, and it stays mostly outside the brain. That makes it useful for blocking opioid effects in the gut while leaving the brain largely untouched.
fact.zh: 它是身體由納曲酮（naltrexone）代謝出的主要化合物，而且大多留在腦外。因此它適合用來阻斷腸道中的鴉片類作用，同時幾乎不影響大腦。
fact.zhHans: 它是身体由纳曲酮（naltrexone）代谢出的主要化合物，而且大多留在脑外。因此它适合用来阻断肠道中的鸦片类作用，同时几乎不影响大脑。
